scripts.sidecar: cargo build --release -p openhydra-agent --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml && mkdir -p src-tauri/target/release && cp ../target/release/openhydra-agent src-tauri/target/release/openhydra-agent && (cp src-tauri/binaries/openhydra-scorer-$(rustc -vV | awk '/host:/{print $2}') src-tauri/target/release/openhydra-scorer 2>/dev/null || echo "no staged openhydra-scorer (run ./stage-sidecar.sh): Ollama models can't be authenticity-checked in dev") && echo "sidecar refreshed: $(ls -la src-tauri/target/release/openhydra-agent | awk '{print $6,$7,$8}')"
